gaps.explanation: The JSON business-type receipts (67,155) come from Exhibit H (p8, accrual, columns Sewer Fund / Water Fund): Total operating revenues 66,972 + Interest income 183. Detail holds only the Schedule 7 (p15, budgetary cash basis) fund totals Sewer 121,105 (index 48) and Water 45,592 (index 49) = 166,697; Sewer 121,105 includes the 98,624 transfer from other funds. The p8 fund columns tie exactly to the statement lines, so the p8 column rows are added: Sewer Utility collections 22,065 + Interest income 165 = 22,230 (Deposits, hookup fees prints 0); Water Utility collections 44,882 + Deposits, hookup fees 25 + Interest income 18 = 44,925. Once added, Schedule 7 lines 48 and 49 count the same funds' receipts a second time (same money, cash basis), so they are removed; the transfer that was inside line 48 gets its own line (Sewer Fund Transfers In 98,624, see transfers_net entry), so no money is lost. Check: 166,697 - 166,697 + 67,155 = 67,155 = statement.

gaps.explanation: The JSON business-type disbursements (94,169) are Exhibit H (p8) Total operating expenses. Detail holds the Schedule 7 (p15, budgetary cash) fund totals Sewer 120,582 (index 50) and Water 52,421 (index 51) = 173,003 (cash: no depreciation, includes the Sewer capital purchases 92,655 shown on the p9 cash flows). The p8 columns tie exactly to the statement lines, so the p8 rows are added: Sewer Personal services 25,242 + Repairs, maintenance 1,180 + Utilities 828 + Supplies 235 + Depreciation 9,542 = 37,027 (Other prints 0); Water 25,242 + 1,075 + 17,067 + Other 560 + 3,952 + 9,246 = 57,142. Lines 50 and 51 then count the same funds' spending a second time (same money, cash basis) and are removed. Check: 173,003 - 173,003 + 94,169 = 94,169 = statement Total operating expenses 94,169 (p8).
